Q: Zig Zag horizontal lines A:

I would create a user-defined object you can keep track of multiple things regarding the horizontal line you want to create.

type h_line
    bool is_high = false
    bool is_broken = false
    float price = na
    line horizontal_line = na

Then, whenever you want to create your horizontal line, create an object of h_line and put it in a var array.

var my_hline_arr = array.new<h_line>()

if (new_HH)
    new_obj = h_line.new(is_high=true, price=<HH price>, horizontal_line=line.new(<create your line>))
    array.push(my_hline_arr, new_obj)

On each bar, loop over the array and process the information.

len = array.size(my_hline_arr)

if (len > 0)
   for i = 0 to len - 1
      obj = array.get(my_hline_arr, i)

      if (not obj.is_broken)  // Only process unbroken lines
          line.set_x2(obj.horizontal_line, bar_index)  // Extend the line

          if (obj.is_high)
              if (high > obj.price)  // Check if line is broken
                  obj.is_broken := true  // It is broken: Alert, remove the line etc.

This should give you an idea.

Q: How to access a repository from a Worker created by a Broadcast Receiver? A:

In CheckInWorker, ctx is a Context. Given a Context, you can get the Application singleton via getApplicationContext():

val application = ctx.applicationContext as CheckInApplication

Q: LEFT JOIN Duplicating Rows A:

With this query:

select t1.*, t2.routing 
from table1 t1 left join table2 t2
on t2.studentid = t1.studentid

or this:

select t1.*, t2.routing 
from table1 t1 left join table2 t2
on t2.bankaccount = t1.bankaccount

you get these results:

> studentid | bankaccount |  gpa | semester | routing
> --------: | ----------: | ---: | :------- | :------
>         1 |      123456 |      | Fall     | abc    
>         1 |      123456 |      | Spring   | abc    
>         1 |      123456 |      | Summer   | abc    
>         2 |      456789 |      | Fall     | def    
>         2 |      456789 |      | Spring   | def    
>         2 |      456789 |      | Summer   | def    
>         3 |      321654 |      | Fall     | ghi    
>         3 |      321654 |      | Spring   | ghi    
>         3 |      321654 |      | Summer   | ghi
